title: research_route exhausts its bound and still collects
intent: Pin research_route's loop bound: after maxIterations 3 the onExhausted target is research_collect, not graceful_failure — the run keeps the best digest it has.

input.featureRequest: Accept a new optional config block and validate it.

request.featureRequest: Accept a new optional config block and validate it.

response.coreProblem: Config parsing rejects the new block instead of validating it.
assumptions: The block is optional and absent in every existing config.
unknowns: Whether the block may appear more than once.
response.successLooksLike: A malformed block yields a typed error naming the offending key.

request.userPrompt: Accept a new optional config block and validate it.

questions: Where is the config parsed today?
What happens to an unknown block?
Is there a typed error class already?
response.findings: The parser lives in src/config/parse.ts and drops unknown blocks silently; ConfigError already exists.

sections.architecture: One parse entry point, called from the CLI and from the library surface.
sections.patterns: Zod schemas per block, composed at the top level.
sections.conventions: Typed errors extend ConfigError and carry the offending key.
sections.risks: Silently dropping unknown blocks means a typo is invisible today.
